Algorithmic Media & Visualizations

A browsable gallery of autonomous 2D physics simulations, Euclidean square tilings, Voronoi diagrams, and graph algorithms continuously updated from GitHub Actions.

🎾 Random Angle Ball Collision Videos

2D continuous physics simulation with slow, analytical speeds (160–260 px/s) and organic random inward angles (±75° fan). Balls duplicate upon border impacts until reaching N balls, followed by a 30-second floating ensemble showcase with spatial pentatonic stereo audio.

📐 Euclidean Algorithm GCD Grid Visualizations

Geometric Euclidean square tiling of a × b rectangles down to gcd(a, b) × gcd(a, b) squares. Rendered with demonstration-scale typography and guaranteed minimum 110 × 110 px tile boxes so all dimensions are clearly legible.
